research_gate.title: Stage B fast-channel state-family research gate
research_gate.blocked_experiment: The source-command Stage 1 clamp authenticated seven independent failures in fast-sodium activation/deactivation and Kv3-like deactivation, so compartment integration and conductance calibration are stopped.
research_gate.wall_reason: The filed equation-derived gate roots and current-to-gate time conversions preserve some equilibrium endpoints but do not reproduce the complete powered current while activation, inactivation, and recovery states evolve together.
research_gate.query: SNr transient sodium and Kv3 complete voltage-clamp current state model activation deactivation transition rates

prior_attempts.summary: V1 treated source normalized-conductance Boltzmann curves as unpowered gates and was superseded before execution because m^3 and n^4 shifted the measured curves.
V2 applied equation-derived roots and conditional current-to-gate time conversions, but seven complete-current source gates failed under the sealed command protocols.

questions.text: Which directly reported transition-rate equations or complete-current model parameters reproduce transient sodium activation midpoint, slope, and 10-90 percent rise together under the Ding, Wei, and Zhou SNr command protocol?

Which directly reported sodium transition rates reproduce the composite transient-current deactivation tail at minus 40 mV without breaking the accepted inactivation and biexponential recovery endpoints?

Which directly reported Kv3-like transition-rate equations reproduce complete-current deactivation tails at minus 60, minus 50, and minus 40 mV while preserving the accepted activation, inactivation, and rise endpoints?

Which coupled closed, open, fast-inactivated, slow-recovery, and blocked states are required by primary evidence for the SNr transient sodium current, and which transitions can be omitted without replacing biological channel dynamics with host logic?
Which Kv3.1 and Kv3.4 subunit or state composition is supported for SNr IDR-fast, and what coupled activation-inactivation topology is required to represent its measured current tails?
